chooser.title: Vent-Clip Figures ($19) — Best for Character & Simplicity
chooser.body: Astronaut, Bear, Guitar, and Pear figures clip onto any air vent. Waterless felt/oil core, refillable in seconds. The most affordable entry point — and genuinely display-worthy on your dash.

chooser.title: Machined Metal Disc ($34) — Best for a Minimal, Grown-Up Look
chooser.body: Solid machined metal with a magnetic snap top. No novelty shape — just a sleek two-piece disc that clips to your vent and arrives gift-boxed. Waterless refillable felt pad.

chooser.title: Pulse Smart Spray ($39) — Best for Hands-Free Timed Scenting
chooser.body: The only model that sprays on its own. Set a mist timer, choose one of three intensity levels, and let it run. Ambient light ring for night drives. USB-C rechargeable.

chooser.title: Guitar Swaying Figure ($19) — Best for Music Lovers
chooser.body: Sways gently with airflow on a 360° rotating silicone clip. Waterless refillable scent core, works on any air vent. A quiet, movement-based detail for the dash.

faqs.question: Do I need a subscription for a car diffuser?
faqs.answer: Not with Autivara. Every model is a one-time purchase — you fill it with any essential or fragrance oil you already own, and refill it whenever you like. There is no subscription, no proprietary vial system, and no recurring charge required to keep using it.

faqs.question: Which Autivara car diffuser lasts longest?
faqs.answer: All Autivara car diffusers are refillable indefinitely, so the diffuser itself doesn't expire. Scent longevity between refills depends on the oil you use and the output setting you choose. The Rechargeable Car Diffuser ($39) and the Pulse Smart Spray ($39) both have adjustable output modes that let you stretch each fill further by starting at the lowest setting and increasing only as needed.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a waterless car diffuser and a regular car air freshener?
faqs.answer: A traditional disposable air freshener (hanging card, gel vent clip, or plastic unit) has a fixed fragrance baked in — once it fades in 2–4 weeks, you throw it away and buy another. A waterless car diffuser like Autivara's uses a dry felt pad or scent core that you recharge with a few drops of any oil. You choose the scent, control the intensity, and reuse the same unit indefinitely — no single-use plastic waste, no locked-in fragrance, no subscription.

/industrial.heading: Commercial Scent Diffusers — Waterless Control Without a Service Contract
/industrial.intro: Choose a commercial scent diffuser by installation method and space type: plug-in for a small room, wall-mounted Wi-Fi control for a mid-size lobby or showroom, or HVAC integration for whole-venue distribution. Autivara equipment is purchased outright, uses waterless nebulizing, and lets you manage fragrance oil without a required scent-service subscription.

chooser.title: Smart Plug-In ($79) — Start with One Small Space
chooser.body: A direct-to-outlet diffuser for a small office, guest suite, treatment room, or compact retail area. It needs no mounting or wiring and includes app-based scheduling and intensity control.

chooser.title: Atmos Wi-Fi Wall Diffuser ($149) — Manage a Mid-Size Customer Area
chooser.body: A wall-mounted waterless system designed for offices, lobbies, salons, and mid-size showrooms. Schedule operating times and adjust strength in the Wi-Fi app, then use the magnetic refill bay for oil changes.

chooser.title: Atmos Pro HVAC ($349) — Distribute Scent Across a Venue
chooser.body: The largest system in the Atmos range connects to existing HVAC ductwork and sends fragrance through the venue's vents. App controls provide scheduling and intensity adjustment for whole-venue operation.

faqs.question: Do Autivara commercial scent diffusers require a contract?
faqs.answer: No required scent-service contract is attached to these diffusers. You purchase the equipment outright and manage its waterless fragrance-oil refills. Your operating cost therefore depends on the oil you choose, the schedule, and the intensity setting rather than a mandatory monthly service plan.

faqs.question: How much does commercial scenting cost?
faqs.answer: Autivara's current equipment prices are $79 for the Smart Plug-In, $149 for the Atmos Wi-Fi Wall Diffuser, and $349 for the Atmos Pro HVAC. Ongoing fragrance cost varies with your oil, operating hours, and intensity, so a universal monthly estimate would be misleading. Start at the lowest practical intensity and adjust after observing the space.

faqs.question: Which diffuser size should I choose for my business?
faqs.answer: Choose by installation and layout rather than an unsupported one-size-fits-all square-foot claim. Use the Smart Plug-In for one smaller room, the wall-mounted Atmos Wi-Fi for a mid-size customer area, and the Atmos Pro HVAC when you need distribution through existing ductwork across a larger venue. Room shape, airflow, doors, ceiling height, and desired intensity all affect real coverage.

faqs.question: Are these commercial diffusers waterless?
faqs.answer: Yes. The commercial range uses waterless fragrance delivery, so there is no water tank to fill. The Atmos systems nebulize fragrance oil, while each product's controls let you manage its operating schedule and intensity.
